recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any future change to multi-column Questionnaire rendering should target the SDC IG or FHIR Extension Pack artifact that owns the affected definition, not the core Questionnaire source.
issue_request: FHIR-15667 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested richer Questionnaire.item rendering controls: a choiceColumn extension for choice/openChoice columns, width control for table columns, additional table itemControl codes, and examples.
initial_application: Historical core commit b8c5990ac5 explicitly named 15667 and added Questionnaire choiceColumn/width extension rows and itemControl concepts table, htable, gtable, and atable. No pre-existing combined-branch Issue-Reconcile-Key commit was found before this worker published the audit.
additional_context: FHIR-19527 later moved questionnaire-choiceColumn and questionnaire-width from FHIR core to the SDC IG. Current SDC source defines sdc-questionnaire-choiceColumn and sdc-questionnaire-width, documents their use with itemControl table rendering, and includes examples. Current FHIR Extension Pack source defines questionnaire-itemControl and the questionnaire-item-control code system with table, htable, and gtable. FHIR-20944 removed atable as redundant, and FHIR-32664 clarified the table/htable common-answer-list guidance that came from FHIR-15667.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. Re-adding the moved SDC extensions or restoring atable in core would conflict with later Published decisions; the relevant current definitions are present in the repositories that now own them.

related_jiras.note: Moved questionnaire-choiceColumn and questionnaire-width from core to SDC, explaining their current absence from core.
Removed the atable itemControl code as redundant with table, explaining why the original atable application should not be restored.
Clarified table/htable guidance so child questions provide enumerated options and should share the same options/value set/expression.
Separate Vocabulary issue for ValueSet expansion filter/display-property behavior that FHIR-15667 identified as related to multi-column choice display.
